messages:
leah-cs: FYI Quasar reserved pool warmup TOMORROW 09:00 PT. Need a short dry-run (quota check, autoscale smoke, loadtest). @omar-eng @jin-sre @cara-ops please claim tasks. maria-billing can you confirm temporary quota increase?

omar-eng: I can run the dry-run and provide recommended autoscale params for Quasar's app. Plan: shadow 20r/s for 20m, ramp to 200r/s over 8m, pinned model rdx-7b-serve-v1.

maria-billing: One-off quota bump approved for warmup window. I'll post invoice note.

jin-sre: Autoscale baseline: min=1 max=16 target_cpu=60 scale_cooldown=90s. Abort if p99 > 2s for 5m or 5xx > 3% for 2m. Will monitor from 08:50-10:30 PT.

cara-ops: Load script ready: `./bin/loadgen --rps 20 --dur 1200 --model rdx-7b-serve-v1 --scenario quasar-warm` CI job queued as `ci/quasar-warmup.yaml`. Will upload artifacts to s3.

leah-cs: Pre-run checklist: billing visible, KMS enabled, prefix cache primed, smoke test green. Reply ack when done.

ci-bot: Job scheduled: `quasar-warmup-1749999998`.

omar-eng: Priming done, smoke test ok. Starting shadow now.

cara-ops: Ramp phase active.

jin-sre: Observed p99 ~1.1s, errors 0.7%, replicas peaked 11. Within guardrails.

cara-ops: Run complete. Artifacts: s3://redwood-warmups/quasar/1749999998/{summary.csv,metrics.png}.

omar-eng: Post-run: requests 240k, p50 95ms, p90 280ms, p99 980ms, errors 0.7%, peak_replicas 11. Recommend customer autoscale: min=2 max=14 target_cpu=62, brief headroom +2 for 5m.

leah-cs: Thanks team  I'll add the run summary to the onboarding packet and schedule RC at 10:30 PT for sign-off.
